You are implementing Task 2: YouTube Video Details Ingestion & VideoTarget Enrichment

## Task Description

Read your task brief first: /Volumes/projects/meal-pilot/.superpowers/sdd/task-2-brief.md
It contains the full task text from the plan, including exact file paths, interfaces, and test cases.

Report file: /Volumes/projects/meal-pilot/.superpowers/sdd/task-2-report.md
Write your detailed report into this file, and return only status (DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, NEEDS_CONTEXT, or BLOCKED), commit hash, a one-line test summary, and any concerns in your response.

## Context

Where this fits: In MealPilot, YouTube videos are discovered or supplied by the caller. `YouTubeVideoDetails` is populated from the YouTube Data API `videos.list`. We need to extract `channelId` and `description` from `snippet` (which is already requested in the API call) with zero extra quota cost, update `YouTubeVideoDetails`, update `VideoTarget` with `channelId?: string; description?: string;`, and update `VideoAnalysisService` to propagate `channelId` and `description` into `target`.

Global Constraints:
- Place all imports at the top of the module (no inline imports)
- In switch statements over discriminated unions, use exhaustive never check in default case

## Your Job

Follow TDD:
1. Write the failing tests in `src/youtube/youtube.service.spec.ts`
2. Run test to verify failure (`npm test src/youtube/youtube.service.spec.ts`)
3. Implement `src/youtube/youtube.interface.ts`, `src/youtube/youtube.service.ts`, `src/videos/analyzers/video-analyzer.interface.ts`, and `src/videos/video-analysis.service.ts`
4. Run test to verify it passes
5. Commit with message: "feat: populate video description and channelId in YouTubeVideoDetails and VideoTarget"
6. Write your report to `/Volumes/projects/meal-pilot/.superpowers/sdd/task-2-report.md`
7. Report back with status, commit SHA, and test summary.
